text: 【财政部副部长廖岷出席2026年首次金砖国家财长和央行行长会议】8月12至13日，2026年首次金砖国家财长和央行行长会议在印度斋浦尔举行。会议围绕全球经济增长与发展、完善国际货币金融体系以及基础设施投资、海关和税收、新开发银行、金砖财金智库网络等财金合作议题进行了讨论。财政部副部长廖岷率团出席会议并发言。
text_en: 【Vice Finance Minister Liao Min Attends First BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of 2026】 From August 12 to 13, the first BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of 2026 was held in Jaipur, India. The meeting discussed topics on global economic growth and development, improving the international monetary and financial system, as well as infrastructure investment, customs and taxation, the New Development Bank, and the BRICS Finance and Think Tank Network. Vice Finance Minister Liao Min led a delegation to attend the meeting and delivered a speech.
